Parse quoted Jinja variables in SQL text without recovery

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"jinja2"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE \'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe\'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT \'x\' OUTPUTFORMAT \'y\'\nLOCATION \'s3://{{bucket}}/t/\'\nTBLPROPERTIES (\'k\'=\'v\');', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.language);
    stdout.writeln(result.metrics.errorCount);
    stdout.writeln(result.metrics.totalBytes);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
